mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_structured_capability (model_ref, version, modes, keywords, limits, thinking_compat, multimodal_downgrade, prompt_keyword, max_tokens_advice, stability, refusal_signal, truncation_signal, verified_at, conformance, create_by, update_by) VALUES (#{row.modelRef}, #{row.version}, #{row.modes,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::jsonb, #{row.keywords,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::jsonb, #{row.limits,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::jsonb, #{row.thinkingCompat,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::jsonb, #{row.multimodalDowngrade}, #{row.promptKeyword}, #{row.maxTokensAdvice}, #{row.stability}, #{row.refusalSignal}, #{row.truncationSignal}, #{row.verifiedAt}, #{row.conformance}, 'system', 'system') ON CONFLICT (model_ref) DO UPDATE SET version = EXCLUDED.version, modes = EXCLUDED.modes, keywords = EXCLUDED.keywords, limits = EXCLUDED.limits, thinking_compat = EXCLUDED.thinking_compat, multimodal_downgrade = EXCLUDED.multimodal_downgrade, prompt_keyword = EXCLUDED.prompt_keyword, max_tokens_advice = EXCLUDED.max_tokens_advice, stability = EXCLUDED.stability, refusal_signal = EXCLUDED.refusal_signal, truncation_signal = EXCLUDED.truncation_signal, verified_at = EXCLUDED.verified_at, conformance = EXCLUDED.conformance, update_at = now(), update_by = 'system'
